programme.title: Black Nativity

programme.title: Albany Road

programme.title: Lady Snowblood
programme.desc: A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

programme.title: Lady Snowblood 2: Love Song Of Vengeance
programme.desc: To avoid a death sentence for her prior acts of bloodshed, the vengeful swordswoman Lady Snowblood is conscripted by the Japanese Secret Police to assassinate political dissidents.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: Green Room
programme.desc: After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights, and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose offhand arrogance triggers a tragedy that ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he’s never been seen before: finding the hero’s heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: The Ides of March
programme.desc: Ambition seduces, and power corrupts in a nerve-wracking thriller from Academy Award-nominated director George Clooney (Good Night, and Good Luck). Rating: R

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Beauty is both deceiving and dangerous in this dark twist on Hans Christian Andersen's classic tale, as an underwater discovery draws an innocent man into a mermaid's evil world.

programme.title: X (2022)
programme.desc: A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

programme.title: The Doors
programme.desc: Jim Morrison, one of the most sensual figures in the history of rock and roll, explodes on the screen in “THE DOORS,” the electrifying movie about a time called the sixties and a legendary outlaw who rocked America’s consciousness – forever.

programme.title: At First Sight
programme.desc: AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.

programme.title: Go
programme.desc: Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Godzilla (1998)
programme.desc: When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Inherit the Viper
programme.desc: For siblings Kip and Josie, dealing opioids isn't just their family business -- it's their only means of survival. But when a deal goes fatally wrong, Kip ignites a powder keg of violence and betrayal as he tries to quit the life for good.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: Against the Ropes
programme.desc: Against the Ropes stars Meg Ryan as Kallen, a sassy, brassy boxing manager-in-the-making determined to change "Lethal" Luther Shaw from a mere street punk into a world-class prizefighter.

programme.title: Beauty Shop (2005)
programme.desc: Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: On a rescue mission, the USS Enterprise is attacked by Krall, a warlord sworn against the Federation. Crashed on an uncharted world, the crew must join forces with Jaylah, a rebellious alien warrior, to escape and stop Krall from triggering all-out war.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Sanctified

programme.title: Billy the Kid

programme.title: The Last Airbender

programme.title: The Goonies

programme.title: The Mummy (1999)

programme.title: MaXXXine

programme.title: The Innkeepers

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

programme.title: Blue Chips

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can

programme.title: Pulp Fiction

programme.title: Next of Kin

programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
programme.desc: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: In 1776, South Carolina widower and legendary war hero Benjamin Martin (Mel Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family torn apart by the savage British Redcoats.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: When a gang of bank robbers makes a run for the border, they wander into the wrong bar and mess with the wrong vampires. It's kill-or-be-killed in the ultimate battle to stop these evil creatures and save their own lives!

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Winner of 2 Academy Awards, including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.

programme.title: Supercop (1996)
programme.desc: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: The con is on when scam artists and lovers Irving Rosenfeld and Sydney Prosser are entrapped by ambitious FBI agent Richie DiMaso and coerced into participating in a sting operation that hinges on snaring politician Carmine Polito and his associates.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: Infinite
programme.desc: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: The Wasp
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: This thriller follows Heather and Carla, who meet after not having spoken in years. Heather is about to present a very unexpected proposition that could change their lives forever.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on an assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After being released from prison, Leo Handler (Mark Wahlberg) takes a job with his powerfully influential Uncle Frank (James Caan). Leo soon finds himself unwittingly drawn into a world of sabotage, high-stakes payoffs and even murder.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: Go
programme.desc: Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: The Matrix Revolutions
programme.desc: In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the machines' onslaught that has enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Colonel Terry Childers is a patriot and war hero. But when a peacekeeping mission he leads in Yemen goes terribly wrong, he finds himself facing a court-martial.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: In this action-packed comedy, Nicolas Cage plays Nick Cage, channeling his iconic characters as he's caught between a superfan (Pedro Pascal) and a CIA agent (Tiffany Haddish).

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top protection agent gets a new client: a hitman who came in from the cold. After being on the opposite ends of a bullet for years, they must team up and have only 24 hours to get to The Hague to bring down a murderous dictator.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

programme.title: Secret Headquarters
programme.desc: Young Charlie Kincaid, who discovers a secret headquarters under his home that seems to belong to a superhero. He shares it with his friends, and they start to believe that his estranged father might have a secret double life.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
programme.desc: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: Before the sun sets, Craig must get his friend out of trouble, find a new job so his parents don't evict him, escape his girlfriend long enough to capture a new woman's heart, and survive a confrontation with the neighborhood menace.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs to his lottery-winning uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Wolf Hound
programme.desc: In this thrilling WWII epic, a US pilot shot down over Germany must singlehandedly battle Nazi troops to thwart a doomsday plot involving a superbomb that can destroy whole cities.

programme.title: Devotion
programme.desc: Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

programme.desc: A charming rhyme for children that teaches them the alphabet, including many now politically-incorrect things, dangerous sequences, and some plagiarism.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Archie Shepp All Star
programme.sub-title: Archie Shepp All Star - Tribute to John Coltrane
programme.desc: In 1960, Archie Shepp attended a concert of John Coltrane at the Five Spot, legendary club of the Lower East Side. Fascinated, he quickly decided to devote himself to the tenor saxophone. Five years later, Shepp - already a staple of free jazz - finally recorded alongside his idol. The result, published in 1966, is called Ascension and still remains today a symbol of free improvisation. At the edge of the fiftieth anniversary of Coltrane's death, gone at forty, the most Parisian of the New York avant-garde celebrates the legacy of the great composer of A Love Supreme with a dazzling French-American all-star who is reminiscent in some respects of the heretic Ascension orchestra. When a giant pays tribute to a god of jazz...

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon, George Gruntz, Guy Pedersen & Daniel Humair
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 & '64 features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others. One of the most influential saxophonists in jazz history, Dexter Gordon is captured in sharp form and style in this 70-minute tour de force.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer's Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the third movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan's performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 1 in F major, Op. 18, No. 1 String Quartet No. 10 in E-flat major, Op. 74, "Harp" and String Quartet No. 9 in C major, Op. 59, No. 3, "Razumovsky". This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on October 13, 2020.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the costume design and fashion moments from Mike Nichols' 1988 film "Working Girl," starring Melanie Griffith, Sigourney Weaver, and Harrison Ford. The hosts explore how Ann Roth's costume choices—from Tess's working-class Staten Island attire to her polished corporate wardrobe—reflect her transformation from secretary to executive. They discuss iconic 80s trends including big hair, commuter shoes, bold eyeshadow, shoulder pads, and the evolution of her style throughout the film, analyzing how fashion serves as a character development tool.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London return to discuss costume design in the three-hour action film "One Battle After Another," exploring eight key looks worn by characters including revolutionary Perfidia Beverly Hills (Teyana Taylor), Bob Ferguson (Leonardo DiCaprio), and other ensemble cast members. The hosts praise costume designer Colleen Atwood's deliberate approach to wardrobe, analyzing how choices like safety orange camouflage, a pregnant character in military gear, and carefully detailed thrift-store aesthetics serve the story without becoming distracting. The conversation examines how costume design can be both detailed and subtly supportive of character development, comparing this film's approach to other cinema styles and discussing how clothing choices communicate character archetypes and backgrounds.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum artist Darius Rucker joins Joel Madden to reflect on his journey from fronting Hootie & the Blowfish to becoming a country music icon. Rucker opens up about balancing family and touring, the band’s legacy, and the honesty that drives his songwriting. He also discusses breaking barriers in country music and his new memoir, Life’s Too Short, offering heartfelt insight into perseverance and authenticity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Dasha. Born in San Luis Obispo, California, Dasha started performing at ten and released her first song at thirteen. After years as an independent artist, her 2023 single "Austin (Boots Stop Workin')" went viral and landed her a deal with Warner Records. Since then, she's made her Grand Ole Opry debut, joined the Spotify Billions Club, and toured with Thomas Rhett and Luke Bryan.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Pat Monahan of Train about their success, scoring Begin Again, and the band's upcoming tour.

programme.title: Jessi Cruickshank: Minivan Money
programme.desc: Comedian and TV host Jessi Cruickshank takes the stage in Toronto for her first stand-up special, Minivan Money. Known as “the funniest woman on television” (The Province), Cruickshank dives into the chaos of motherhood with biting honesty and fearless humor. From pumping breastmilk onstage to lusting after preschool dads, she turns the absurd realities of parenting into sharp, self-aware comedy. Blending storytelling, satire, and confessional wit, this live performance captures a comedian in full command of her craft — raw, real, and hilariously relatable.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.

programme.title: The Portillo Expedition: Mystery on the Bougainville Island
programme.desc: THE PORTILLO EXPEDITION: MYSTERY ON BOUGAINVILLE ISLAND examines the circumstances surrounding the death of Isoroku Yamamoto the Japanese WWII Admiral who planned the Pearl Harbor surprise attack and the Battle at Midway. Admiral Yamamotos plane, the Betty Bomber, was shot down by American P-38 fighter planes in 1943. Narrated by Gary Sinise, the documentary follows a crew of American explorers to the remote jungle of the western Solomon Islands, where they search for the wreck of the Betty Bomber sparking a further quest to understand what they find there.

programme.title: Stories of Survival
programme.desc: In early summer 1944, at the apex of the deportation of Hungarian Jews, Magda Brown and George Brent arrived as teenagers to the notorious Auschwitz-Birkenau killing center. Through their eyes, this film takes the viewer on a compelling journey across multiple countries and camps, revealing the intensely human aspects of survival, resistance, chance, and luck in the face of Nazi tyranny.

programme.title: Swimming in Auschwitz
programme.desc: A gripping documentary, SWIMMING IN AUSCHWITZ sheds light on the Holocaust experience from the rarely explored perspective of six women imprisoned inside the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp. The intertwined stories of survivors Eva Beckmann, Rena Drexler, Renee Firestone, Erika Jacoby, Lili Majzner and Linda Sherman illustrate their individual, yet universal, Holocaust experiences.The womens lives slowly morphed into a never-ending saga of persecution and ghettoization. Starting in 1942, Nazis herded Jewish women from Poland, Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Holland onto cattle cars and transported them through the gates of Auschwitz-Birkenau. Separated from family after three or more days on a train with no food or water, stripped of their clothes, their heads shaved and their arms tattooed, they often spent the first night outdoors with the smell of the crematoria in the air.In the ensuing months, their survival within the camp depended largely on luck, yet the six women just teenagers at the time found ways to keep their hope alive. The prisoners maintained a spiritual resistance through prayer, community, music and even humor. Through surprising anecdotes, these women reveal the unlikely role laughter played in their survival. The film's title derives from its most powerful story. Marching through the camp on a particularly hot August day, the group passed by a swimming pool kept for Nazi officers. For one of the women, this sight was just too tempting. To the shock of the rest of the group, she jumped in the pool and swam from one end to the other.The compelling testimonials in this film demonstrate the Nazis' failure to crush the will of Jews. The women profiled do not dwell on the physical and emotional hardships; instead, they speak of camp families and faith, and the ways in which they tried to uplift one another and retain their humanity. Their stories reveal the power of laughter and community, even in the face of unimaginable evil.

programme.title: Shanghai 1937: Where World War II Began
programme.desc: When did World War II begin? For Europeans, it was September 1, 1939 when Nazi Germany invaded Poland. Americans might say December 7, 1941the day the Japanese Imperial navy attacked the American naval base at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii. But in China, people will tell you a different dateAugust 13, 1937, the start of the Battle of Shanghai. That day, after what is called the century of humiliation, including six years of incidents initiated by the Japanese military, China at last stood up.At the time, Shanghai was the most international city in Asia with a large foreign population, so the military conflict made headline news around the world. Based on the book Shanghai 1937: Stalingrad on the Yangtze by Danish author Peter Harmsen, SHANGHAI 1937: WHERE WORLD WAR II BEGAN introduces key figures in the conflict, chronicles how the battle unfolded over the course of three months, and explores the aftermath and years of war that followed. SHANGHAI 1937 incorporates rarely seen archival footage as well as interviews with author Peter Harmsen, military historian Edward Drea and professor of modern Chinese history Hans Van DeVen, in addition to two Chinese experts on this subject: Su Zhiliang, Ph.D. of Shanghai Normal University, and Ma Zhendu, director of the Second Historical Archives of China. The film also includes vivid recollections of men and women who experienced these events as foreign children living in Shanghai.

programme.title: Nat Turner: A Troublesome Property
programme.desc: In 1831, Nat Turner led a slave rebellion in the United States that resulted in the murder of local slave owners and their families, the eventual execution of 55 rebels and the retribution lynching of more than 200 innocent slaves. Nat Turner: A Troublesome Property examines how the story of Turner’s revolt has been interpreted throughout history and how it continues to raise new questions about the nature of terrorism and other forms of violent resistance to oppression.Literary works have portrayed Turner as everything from an ambivalent cultural hero to a revolutionary to an apocalyptic prophet. The film adopts an innovative structure by interspersing documentary footage and interviews with dramatizations of these different versions of Turner’s story.A unique collaboration between MacArthur Genius Award feature director Charles Burnett, acclaimed historian of slavery Kenneth S. Greenberg and Academy Award-nominated documentary producer Frank Christopher, Nat Turner is a compelling look at one of history’s most mysterious figures.

programme.title: The Kennedy Half-Century
programme.desc: The Kennedy Half-Century chronicles the enduring impact of John F. Kennedy's life and policies on the U.S. presidency since JFK's tragic death in 1963. From Lyndon Johnson's Great Society to Ronald Reagan's tax cuts and Cold War strategies, from Bill Clinton's infatuation with Kennedy to the similarities between JFK and Barack Obama in the 2008 presidential campaign, The Kennedy Half-Century explores the legacy of JFK over the past fifty years. Based on the new book by Larry Sabato, the compelling one hour documentary features archival photos of Kennedy's assassination and funeral, historic moments and interviews with major political and media figures, including Bob Schieffer, Ron Reagan Jr., Kathleen Kennedy Townsend, Ari Fleischer, James Carville, Julian Bond, Andrew Bell and Larry Sabato, among others.

programme.title: Flying the Feathered Edge: The Bob Hoover Project (v.2)
programme.desc: Legendary pilot Robert A. Bob Hoover is often credited as one of historys greatest aviators. His airplane, Sweetie Face, is on display at the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum in Washington DC. FLYING THE FEATHERED EDGE: THE BOB HOOVER PROJECT chronicles his storied career, from his years as a U.S. Army Air Force fighter pilot in WWII to his daring feats as a civilian test pilot. In his later career as an air show performer, Bob became known for shutting his engines off and feathering his propellers. He would then perform a graceful pattern of loops and rolls, a routine never before or since replicated. Hoover performed in front of more people, in more countries, and in more aircraft than any other pilot. Bobs influence on generations of aviators includes Harrison Ford, Dick and Burt Rutan, Carroll Shelby, Neil Armstrong, General Bud Day, and world-premiere air show pilot Sean D. Tucker. Throughout the documentary, these plane enthusiasts discuss and celebrate Bob's many feats. FLYING THE FEATHERED EDGE: THE BOB HOOVER PROJECT preserves the stories, friendships, and legacy of a beloved pilot who greatly influenced the trajectory of the aviation field.
